research_notes: Resolve station employer/control, AGC legal employer and full-time evidence, 1987–89 gap, 1992 business commencement/operational cessation and hours, Joyce staff dates, and overlaps between business, governance and political work. Review historical company/AGC records and interest-register changes before any headline calculation.

2026-09-29 initial pass: checked official APH biography, primary first speech, conference professional biography, 2005 departmental committee evidence, ABC election/divestment reports, and historical banking archive. Targeted public-profile and annual-report searches did not resolve employment contracts or hours; US Deloitte and musician namesakes rejected.

The six-night courier run and station daylight-to-dark description indicate workload but not a verified continuous substantive full-time spell. Business staff numbers describe other workers, not the member's own FTE. The 25-year transport biography spans ownership and elected office and cannot be converted into eligible years.

Preserve year precision and unknown boundaries. Do not double count courier company interests, committee roles or party activities. Excluded political/governance periods do not establish zero public/private employment elsewhere. Direct APH requests failed but indexed primary passages were available; repeat only with a new archival lead.

2026-10-02 follow-up: primary About Scott page resolves transport managing-director cessation to 2010; ABC 2013 Wright guide resolves Joyce staff cessation to 2010. Added postgraduate education without dates. Targeted university graduation, early staff, AGC and Lifeline searches did not resolve remaining dates/hours; unrelated namesakes rejected. A 27 June 2010 newspaper index identifies then-current chief-of-staff status, but direct page failed and is not required for coded boundaries. Next leads: dated employment/professional records for staff commencement, station employer, AGC entity, 1987–89 gap, continuous hours and business/staff overlap; retained company interests must not extend operational duration.

2026-10-03 follow-up: fresh searches targeted Joyce chief-of-staff commencement, CQX/Toowoomba Express records, AGC role history, Lifeline and regional committee appointments, and full-time/work-overlap evidence. Accessible 2005 departmental committee evidence and 2023 Hansard repeat the existing owner-operator, 14-depot and 105-worker facts; election profiles confirm only that chief-of-staff work continued until the 2010 election. No reliable commencement, hours, leave, station employer, AGC legal entity, 1987–89 work or business/staff overlap evidence was located. Deloitte and US-company namesakes were rejected. No material new career fact; advance to the next member and revisit only with a dated personnel/company archive lead.

2026-10-04 follow-up (second nationwide pass): company-registry targeting located Central Queensland Express Holdings Pty Ltd ACN 087 560 012 with a 13 May 1999 registration date and an ASIC Gazette trace, but neither record establishes Buchholz's personal appointment, operating hours or the 1992–1999 business form. The 2005 Commonwealth committee record remains the best dated owner/operator and Lifeline-board observation. No new staff commencement, station employer, AGC entity, 1987–89 work, hours, leave or business/political overlap evidence surfaced. Treat the company-registration lead as entity context only; revisit personal employment boundaries only if a dated personnel or company filing names him.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted historical Lifeline and university-MBA qualification queries produced overseas finance/Deloitte/donor namesakes or existing maiden speech, not a personal governance term or conferral record. No new supported career fact adopted. Prior CQX registration remains company context only, not his payroll/appointment; no invented1999start. Corrected one-sided precision for existing dated cessation/election fields. Next follow-up requires original Lifeline board report naming him, university conferral list, Joyce appointment record or business/AGC contract; general title/degree queries exhausted.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Primary2014 parliamentary speech on own site identifies Lifeline Queensland state board and specific governance-procedure duties, materially refining generic Lifeline entry. Pre-House retrospective wording does not give exact cessation or paid/FTE status; many hours is not full-time proof. Both engines searched historical board, Joyce staff2006 and AGC employer; existing conference biography/government committee repeats known facts without dates or legal entity. US technology/CIO and law-firm namesakes rejected. Remaining station identity,1987–89 gap, business/staff overlap, individual hours and appointment/leave documents unresolved.
